original_idea.body: # Honesty-Consistency Triangulation Benchmark. Query each model directly, under pressure, indirectly, and by self-report; build a consistency matrix and per-model honesty-stability score. API-only.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Honesty-verification triangulation addresses an explicit UK AISI open problem.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Multi-framing querying + consistency matrix; accessible to beginners, API-only.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused triangulation tool; four query modes x items adds modest breadth.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Reusable honesty tool on open models; AISI-flagged, independent-friendly.

novelty.reasoning: MASK/BeHonest cover honesty; the triangulation-stability angle plausibly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Honesty benchmarks exist; cross-framing triangulation plausibly open.
